global_rules: No arbitrary parent creation or mkdir -p. Only enumerated missing directories may be created.
No-overwrite publication for new paths. Any unexpected existing path, type, owner, mode, parent identity, symlink, or unproved completion causes STOP.
Same-filesystem requirement: staging, destinations and external quarantine must share st_dev. Verify immediately before mutation; no copy/unlink fallback.

Pin every existing ancestor before opening; revalidate descriptors and namespace before and after each operation. Parent timestamps naturally change on child insertion and are logged, not mistaken for an immutable directory identity.
Modes/owners of existing paths are preserved. New directory 0755, ancillary 0644, loose object 0444; metadata retains 0664.
Git object bytes are canonical Git envelope compressed with zlib, not raw blob contents; verify OID, type, length and raw SHA-256 after decompression.
Object and new file publication retains private staging anchors; equality of bytes alone never proves attempt ownership.

kind: Read-only runtime-baseline reconciliation proposal observation; not an authority record
limits: No live-memory introspection; service origin and earlier cached-code equality support deployed-source correspondence. No installer/import, archive verifier/consume call, private package read, DB query or runtime mutation. Secret configuration content and authentication message content are not copied. Snapshot is time-bounded and must be rechecked before any authorized action.
object_preparation_requirement: Separate authorized append-only import of exactly these validated objects; no network fetch, ref movement, garbage collection, repack or runtime source changes during object preparation. Revalidate every target reachable object before metadata transition.

revision.runtime_scope_delta: No new runtime application files, service changes, or features. Explicitly enumerate already-required one documentation directory and nine Git fanout directories, existing metadata/locks, and newly requested external operation-control artifacts.
revision.scope: M1 and M2 only; proposal revision, no runtime execution

rollback_protocol.ambiguous_event_rule: A torn/incomplete event, orphan stage without durable identity proof, unmatched namespace, unexpected state or non-owned content is STOP. Preserve all artifacts; a separately reviewed custody decision is required, never reconstruct authority from filenames/hashes.
rollback_protocol.attempt_id_policy: One fixed attempt namespace, exclusively created. Resume only this recorded attempt; a second attempt requires a new reviewed namespace and approval.
rollback_protocol.control_files_mode: 0600; .original hardlink anchors and staged publication objects deliberately retain their original/target modes inside 0700 parents to avoid changing linked runtime metadata
rollback_protocol.durability: Write complete event; fsync event and ledger directory; then side effect. Fsync staged regular files and containing directory; fsync both parents after link/no-replace rename/exchange; verify exact paths and identities; persist AFTER then DONE with fsync. Directory operations fsync source/destination parents. Never record completion before actual durability checks.
rollback_protocol.exclusive_operator_lock: Acquire flock on the identity-pinned attempt-root directory descriptor; create no lock file. This serializes this procedure only; separately establish no concurrent external Git writer. Without that custody guarantee STOP.
rollback_protocol.ledger_format: Immutable canonical JSON events, one regular 0600 file per event; ledger/<ordinal:06d>-<operation_id>-<event>.json; finite operation IDs from allowlists plus PREPARE, VERIFY, ROLLBACK, FINAL; event enum INTENT, STAGED, BEFORE, AFTER, DONE, STOP. Creation O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW; never truncate/rewrite/delete. Repeated transition reads matching DONE instead of replaying mutation.
rollback_protocol.original_anchor_contract: Original HEAD/index hardlinks preserve original inode, byte content, owner and mode (0664). Anchors remain inside backup 0700. Only original metadata link-count/ctime changes caused by creating anchors are permitted and logged; source modules/authentication objects are never linked or changed. Byte backups are separate 0600 exclusive files.
rollback_protocol.quarantine_order_recovery: For each metadata operation, if live original and lock candidate => before exchange; if live candidate and lock original => after forward exchange; if live original and lock migrated candidate after ROLLBACK_INTENT => after reverse exchange. Exact AFTER/BEFORE records and anchor inode mapping disambiguate. Move lock only to its specified forward-old or rollback-new slot with no replacement. A matching destination plus absent lock is already complete. Any other combination STOP.
rollback_protocol.rollback_identity_limits: Restore original HEAD/index inode and bytes via anchors; do not claim restoration of original ctime, nlink or wall-clock history, which necessarily change.
